summary.intent: Manage the final phases of the cipher-box milestone using the GSD manager: discuss and plan phases 38 and 39, execute phase 38 (retire deprecated web services), and fix an upload progress bar flash bug.
summary.outcome: Phase 38 context, planning, and execution fully completed (2,030 lines of deprecated code removed); Phase 39 context and planning completed, execution launched in background; upload progress flash bug fixed and PR #420 created; simplify review launched but interrupted.

repo: BYO-IPFS config pattern in packages/core/src/vault/types.ts is the established pattern for storing user settings in encrypted vault metadata on IPFS — Phase 39 vault settings should follow this exactly
SDK migration pattern: hooks import SDK methods directly, extract state from Zustand stores, pass as explicit params — see useSharedWriteOps.ts as canonical example
CipherBoxClient.getContext() exists at line 312 of client.ts, enabling SdkContext bridging for callers that need it
folder.service.ts had 3 functions with no SDK equivalent (addFileToFolder, addFilesToFolder, replaceFileInFolder) — these were extracted to packages/sdk-core/src/folder/index.ts during Phase 38
bin.service.ts purgeExpired had no SDK equivalent — added as purgeExpired(retentionDays) on CipherBoxClient during Phase 38
@cipherbox/crypto had a circular devDependency on @cipherbox/core caused solely by vault-ipns.test.ts importing deriveRegistryIpnsKeypair and initializeVault — fixed by hardcoding test vectors
Server-side RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS env var is being deprecated in Phase 39 in favor of per-vault user settings
Settings page has 3 tabs (Linked Methods, Security, Storage) — Phase 39 adds a 4th 'Vault' tab

code.finding: Encrypting state used width: 100% !important on the progress fill bar, causing a flash when first progress event arrived and reset width to 0%. Fixed by using shimmer on the track with fill hidden (opacity: 0) during encryption.
Canonical example of SDK migration pattern: imports SDK functions directly, extracts state from stores, passes as explicit params.
CipherBoxClient.getContext() exists here, enabling SdkContext bridging for callers migrated from service layer.
ByoIpfsConfig is the established pattern for user settings stored in encrypted vault metadata — VaultSettings for Phase 39 should follow this structure.

workflow: Background agents commit on whatever branch they're on, which can diverge from the main working branch — branch reconciliation is needed after parallel agent execution
GSD plan and execute agents can end up on different branches (docs/phase-38-plan vs docs/phase-38-context), requiring manual merge to consolidate artifacts
The GSD init manager tool reads disk state to detect phase completion — it may not detect phases marked [COMPLETE] in ROADMAP.md text vs file-based state
When running parallel background agents and interactive work, stashing changes can inadvertently capture unrelated executor changes — prefer cherry-pick over stash for targeted commits
